description:
#The ultimate fusion of history, speed, and pure excitement!	

THE EXPERIENCE
Imagine the thrill of driving the streets of Boston through the planned Indy Car Street Track!   In a Ferrari or Lamborghini Supercar, you'll drive through the historic and modern edge area of Boston’s Seaport District. This is a unique chance to navigate tight corners with views of Boston Harbor on one side and the iconic skyline on the other. Feel the adrenaline of Ferrari or Lamborghini and feel famous in the the heart of one of America’s oldest cities. It’s the ultimate fusion of history, motorsports, and pure excitement that any racing enthusiast would love to experience.

faqs:
YOUR QUESTIONS ANSWERED
✅ Are you closing/shutting down the roads to re-create the street track?  No, we will simply be driving the route of the Indy Car Designed Street Track during normal public driving operations.

✅ Will I be driving by myself and can my friend/partner ride with me?  No, you will be with one of our instructors.

✅ What if there are partial road closures?  We will make modifications to the street track so you get the same amount of distance driven

✅ How old do you have to be to Drive?  25 Years Old.  If you're under 25, you can be a ride-a-long passenger.

✅ Am I guaranteed my vehicle choice?  Yes, unless the car is in the shop for an unexpected issue.

✅ What's required of me to participate in this experience?  You will need 1).  A positive attitude with No Ego, 2). Signed Participant Waiver, 3).  Must have active auto insurance with comprehensive and collision coverage at a minimum of $250,000, 4). A $5,000 Credit Card Authorization, in case there is an accident.

✅ If I'm driving and get into an accident what happens next?  We will process the $5,000 Security Deposit and then we will go to work with your insurance company to repair.   

✅ What time should I arrive and happens if I'm late for the experience?  Please arrive 10 minutes before your scheduled start time.  If you’re late, you will forfeit your experience.  

✅ What if it’s raining out?  We drive rain or shine, unless there’s a major weather storm, where it’s unsafe.  

✅ Is their Height and Weight Limit?  No more than 6’7 and 340 lbs

✅ Is there a cancellation / refund / reschedule policy?  You have 48 hours to cancel for a full refund or to reschedule your experience.
